data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (IMDb, then Rotten Tomatoes, then a mail draft with the gathered facts, then discard) and the main parameters. It lists director, runtime, rating and score as input parameters when they are scraped values, it drops the friend-name greeting and the "{friend}@example.com" construction, it says "Discard (or Send)" when the draft must not be sent, and it omits the exact body template and the UI clicks, so it is only partly automatable.
